archetypes.name: bash-caller-contract
archetypes.rationale: The KV-emission guard change silently shifts the bash caller contract — shell scripts that source create-branch output need to tolerate absent BRANCH_NAME/ACTION on error paths, and other pr.py verbs with --repo args may have the same missing-validation gap.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the shell scripts (under scripts/) that invoke `cli.py pr create-branch` and parse its KV output: verify that callers correctly handle the case where BRANCH_NAME and ACTION are absent (not just empty) when exit_code is non-zero after the guard change in create_branch_main. Also survey all other `*_main` functions in python/pr.py that accept a `--repo` argument to determine whether any besides checks_main are still missing a _validate_repo_arg call — the fix only adds it to checks_main but the plan describes a systematic pattern gap. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
